docs: move annotations out of resource in embedded resource example (#3462)

* docs: move annotations out of resource in embedded resource example

The embedded resource example in server/tools.mdx nested `annotations`
inside `resource`. `EmbeddedResource` defines `annotations` as a sibling
of `resource`, and `TextResourceContents` has no `annotations` field, so
the example did not validate against the schema. Move `annotations` up
one level in the draft, 2025-11-25, and 2025-06-18 pages to match
`schema.ts` and the `EmbeddedResource` example under `schema/*/examples`.

Fixes #3453

docs: add Kiro Crew to extension support matrix (#3461)

Add Kiro Crew after PostHog Code with MCP Apps support. Kiro Crew renders
MCP Apps (`io.modelcontextprotocol/ui`, 2026-01-26 stable) for stdio servers
routed through its gateway:
https://github.com/kirodotdev/KiroCrew/blob/main/src/kiro_crew/docs/mcp-apps.md

Quick check on the other extensions across Kiro products (2026-10-28):

Kiro Crew
- OAuth Client Credentials: no. The only client_credentials grant is for
  its Microsoft Teams integration, not MCP.
- Enterprise-Managed Authorization: no. Only an AWS identity design
  proposal exists.
- Skills: no. Skills load from local SKILL.md files and kiro-cli's
  `skill://` scheme, not from MCP servers.
- Tasks: no evidence.

Kiro CLI (not added, no extension support)
- MCP Apps: no. Rendering in Kiro Crew comes from the Kiro Crew gateway;
  un-routed servers render as plain text.
- OAuth support (DCR, pre-registered clients, CIMD, clientSecret since
  2.12) is core MCP authorization, not the auth extensions.
- Skills / Tasks: no evidence.

Kiro IDE (not added, no extension support)
- MCP Apps: no. Open feature request:
  https://github.com/kirodotdev/Kiro/issues/11048
- OAuth Client Credentials: no. The IDE supports public OAuth clients only:
  https://kiro.dev/docs/mcp/configuration/
- Enterprise-Managed Authorization: no. Enterprise MCP governance is an
  allowlist and on/off toggle, not IdP-issued tokens:
  https://kiro.dev/docs/enterprise/governance/mcp/
- Skills / Tasks: no evidence.
